info.name: DataConnect — Full E2E (design-aligned, connector-templates → monitoring)
info.description:
Complete functional test suite aligned to the InaiEra DataConnect Technical Design. Run folders 1→11 top-to-bottom in the Collection Runner; ids chain via collection variables.

Base prefix /api/v1/dataconnect; org header X-Org-Id=org_1001 (templates/schemas-infer/monitoring need none).

Canonical pipeline (matches design topic examples):
  topic      = raw-crm-salesforce-accounts-api-v1
  connector  = crm--salesforce--accounts--api--v1
  prepared   = prepared-crm-salesforce-accounts-api-v1
  quarantine = quarantine-crm-salesforce-accounts-validation-v1

Order: 1 Connector Templates -> 2 Connections -> 3 Transforms -> 4 Schemas -> 5 Quality -> 6 Pipelines -> 7 Lifecycle -> 8 Quality Execution -> 9 Schema Drift -> 10 Lineage -> 11 Monitoring.

Covers every implemented endpoint (a superset of design §15), all enum possibilities (source types, zones, modes, SMT categories, quality rule types, drift actions), and NEG cases.
